key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Çalt başlangyç
1. Torque Pro guruň (tölegli wersiýa; Torque Lite plugin goldamaýar) we OBD-II adapteriňizi jübütläň.
2. Bu plugini Torque → Sazlamalar → Pluginler içinde açyň.
3. Habarnamalara rugsat beriň we batareýa ulanyşyny Çäklendirilmedik ediň, Torque bu plugini arka fonda başladyp bilsin.
4. Torque-da sürýän awtoulagyňyzyň ulag profilini saýlaň. Maglumatlar her Torque profili boýunça saklanýar we ulagyň VIN/ECU kimligine garşy barlanýar.
5. Täze profilde birikdireniňizde ýangyç çeşmesi anyklanýar; soralýan bolsa, ony pribor panelindäki görkeziji bilen deňeşdiriň we Tassykla basyň. Tassykla gurmak sahypasynda we habarnamada. Ony aşakdan hem saýlap bilersiňiz.
6. Bu ýerde giriziljek bak ölçegi ýok. Her laýyklyk öz ölçegini öwrenýär, ol Öwrenilen bak ölçegi aşagynda görkezilýär; şol wagta çenli düzedilen göterimi görkeziji bilen 1:1 okáýar. Torque-yň öz galan ýangyjy we DTE üçin bak ölçegini Torque ulag profiline giriziň.
7. Torque-da [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level we her laýyklygyň Corrected % hem Tank size görkezijilerini goşuň. Plagin galan ýangyjy ýa-da DTE ýaýratmaýar. Täzeden laýyklamak habarnamasy şol laýyklyk täzeden laýyklamak gutarýança 1:1 okáýar diýýär.
8. Ýangyç derejesini Torque-a gaýtaryň: Öçürilen, tekizlenen ýa-da Chunk, Band ýa-da Kalman laýyklygyndan düzedilen, 012F görkezijiňize. Soňra Torque-yň öz galan ýangyjy we DTE şol derejäni Torque profilindäki bak ölçegi we uzak möhletli mpg bilen ulanýar.
9. Ýangyç diňe hereketlendiriji işlände hasaplanýar. Plugin diňe Torque ECU-a birikdirilen wagty işleýär.
10. Süremäge we guýmaga dowam ediň; takyklyk birnäçe bölekleýin bakda ösýär. Plagin munuň haýsy ulagdygyny aýdyp bilmese, habarnamada we bu sahypada soraýar; şol ýöriş bilen näme etmelidigini saýlaň.
11. Hemme maglumatlar şu telefonda galýar. GPS ýa-da ýerleşiş ýazga alynmaýar.
